errors.evidence: The horizontal axis is not a simple sequence of four categories. The chart is divided into two main groups, 'EC-15' and 'EC-13', and each of these groups contains the four listed categories.

The description only reports two of these four values for each indicator, omitting half of the data.
The value for 'Износ' (Exports) for EC-15 in the period 2000-2008 is approximately 5.5%, not 7%.
The value for 'Износ' (Exports) for EC-13 in the period 2009-2018 is 5%, not 9%.
The value for 'Внос' (Imports) for EC-15 in the period 2000-2008 is approximately 5.6%, not 9%.
